biography: Brad Stevinson is Vice President at Tract, contributing to data center growth. Their background reflects a transition from clinical practice to real estate development and investment.Prior to Tract, Brad was Vice President, Development & Investment at Trammell Crow, a real estate development firm specializing in commercial real estate properties. Their work history includes a summer associate role at BXP and Boston Properties, where they gained exposure to investment banking and real estate environments.Earlier in their career, Brad practiced medicine. They served as an Emergency Medicine Physician at TeamHealth and as an Emergency Medicine Resident at Denver Health. Their clinical experience also includes a role as a Physician at UCHealth. During this period, they were also a Medical Student Research Fellow at HHMI.
